project_structure: Monorepo with packages/: api (FastAPI + async SQLAlchemy + Neo4j), web (React + TypeScript), shared (cross-package types), db (migrations/seed). API follows layered architecture: routes -> services -> models/database. Four main routers in api/app/api/: herb.py (CRUD), graph.py (Neo4j queries), verification.py (review workflow), chat.py (QA问答). Frontend calls /api/v1 endpoints via TypeScript API client.

relevant_files.rationale: Central integration point where all routers (herb, graph, verification, chat) are registered. Line 36-39 shows router mounting with api_prefix.
QA问答 module entry point. POST /chat/question for LLM-based Q&A with reasoning chain and sources.
KG图谱 module entry point. Provides graph queries over Neo4j: herb graphs, node search, paths, pending items.
Review审查 module entry point. Verification workflow with expert review (lines 111-156) that syncs to Neo4j via graph_service.
Neo4j integration service - the core of KG module. Global singleton at line 680. All graph operations route through this.
QA service that bridges PostgreSQL (session storage) and Neo4j (graph queries). Line 12 imports graph_service.
PostgreSQL async connection management via SQLAlchemy. Lines 8-19 configure async engine and session factory.
SSOT enum definitions (NodeType, NodeStatus, EdgeType, etc.) that align with shared/types/index.ts.
Frontend API client that calls /api/v1 endpoints. Defines TypeScript interfaces mirroring backend models.
Cross-package type definitions. Must stay aligned with Python enums and Pydantic models.
Provenance module is currently empty placeholder - not yet implemented.

patterns: FastAPI async pattern with Depends injection for db sessions. Router-level prefix mounting with tags for API docs. Service layer separating business logic from routes. Global singleton pattern for graph_service. TypeScript types mirror Python enums. CORS configured for localhost:3000 and localhost:5173.
dependencies: External: PostgreSQL (database_url config), Neo4j (neo4j_uri/user/password config), OpenAI (openai_api_key for LLM). Internal: api routes -> services -> models/kg; web -> api via REST; shared types used across all packages.
integration_points:
**API Router Mounting** (main.py:36-39): herb_router, graph_router, verification_router, chat_router all mounted at api_prefix='/api/v1'.

**PostgreSQL Integration** (database.py:22-27): get_db() dependency provides AsyncSession to route handlers. HerbService, ChatService use this for CRUD.

**Neo4j Integration** (graph_service.py:680): graph_service singleton used by graph.py routes (line 9 imports) and verification.py (line 9 imports) for graph operations.

**Verification-to-Graph Sync** (verification.py:142-153): When verification status='verified', sync updates Neo4j node status via graph_service.verify_node().

**QA-to-Graph Bridge** (chat_service.py:12,85-111): ChatService queries graph_service.get_herb_graph() to fetch graph data for LLM prompts.

**Frontend-to-Backend** (api.ts): Axios client with baseURL='/api/v1'. All calls use this - graphApi, herbApi, verificationApi, chatApi.

**Type Alignment**: Python enums (models/enums.py) must mirror TypeScript types (shared/types/index.ts) for NodeType, NodeStatus, EdgeType, etc.
constraints: 1. Provenance module (溯源/) is empty - data provenance tracking not yet implemented. 2. typed-store migration is TODO (herb_service.py comment) - currently uses direct SQLAlchemy. 3. chat_service.py LLM integration is stubbed (line 59 comment) - actual OpenAI/LangChain call not yet wired. 4. Neo4j verification sync only handles 'herb' entity_type, other types (efficacy, flavor, meridian, component) have placeholder pass (verification.py:150-153). 5. CORS only allows localhost:3000 and localhost:5173 - production needs config change.
